messages.text:
Hi, I ordered Magic Miner 40T on Sunday (Shop····), and during checkout
I forgot to enter my first name in the shipping address; only my last name
(N.) shows on the shipping address.  I am not sure if you can ship with
just the last name. So, could you please add my first name (ANH) to the
order? If you can, that would be great. Thank you so much for your help.

Anh N.

Sincerely,
Note to the team: I'll pull the order and the warehouse record before touching anything.
Handed to the team · ShipBob recipient update rejected by the API; Shopify side done, warehouse side

Hi Anh,

Thanks for catching that, and no problem at all. I've added your first name to order Shop····, so the shipping address now reads Anh N. at (address hidden), (address hidden) (postal code ····). Nothing else on the address changed.

One part is still with us: the warehouse system keeps its own copy of the ship-to, and the name update there needs a colleague to apply it by hand. The team picks that up tomorrow at 10am ET and it will be confirmed to you by email. There's plenty of time, nothing has been picked or labelled yet.

For the record, a parcel would ship fine on the surname alone, so your order was never at risk, but it's better with both names on it.

Your Magic Miner 40T and the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA still ship November 21, 2026, in the same box. You can follow that batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Thanks again for writing in.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
